title: Tyrants Will Be Punished!
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'lhamd! Alfu salaat, alfu salaam Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa’l-akhireen habeebullah Rabbi ‘l-`Alameen. As-salaatu
wa-salaam `alaa jami` al-anbiyaa wa ’l-mursaleen wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan ila Yawmi’d-Deen. (Mawlana
Shaykh sits) As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `IbaadAllah.
Yaa Bani Adam! O People! We are just now reaching the last part of the life of Man in dunya. We are saying,
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. New signs of the Last Day
come and appear daily. May Allah forgive us. We are saying, A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
O People! Attenders from east to west, beware as the Last Day is approaching quickly, not slowly.

SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Axheem. Everywhere there is fire that Man is using to burn things. Men have
become oppressors, and Allah Almighty (swt) is saying, `alaa yazaal yaqool. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits) Allah Almighty, Our Creator, Our Lord, said:
“O People! From pre-Eternal to Eternal, I forbid oppression! I am not a Lord Who oppresses, no. That is the

first thing I am making haraam, because I never oppress! I also command and order all prophets, and
through them all of My servants, just as I make oppression haraam for Me, I order oppression haraam for
you! I am never going to forgive oppressors, I will take My heavenly revenge on all oppressors, and as much
as they committed oppression against My servants, I will take revenge on them and punish them here and
Hereafter. I forgive everything except oppression.
“If My servant is not an oppressor, I will take him to My Paradise and it will be enough for him to be there for
Eternity. I will take My revenge on those who say they are Muslims and cause oppression, because I will
never forgive oppressors and tyrants. Never! I will even question a person if they kill an ant without a reason,
and I will take the ant’s revenge on that person. The biggest sin is oppression, and now we are living in a time
when the whole world is filled with it and everyone is an oppressor. I will take My revenge on them before the
Day of Resurrection. Those tyrants are using their power over weak people, killing them, and I will punish
them up to the end.”
This was narrated in a well-known dream about Hajjaj az-Zhaalam, the oppressor, in which he was asked,
“How did your Lord deal with you?” He said, “Everyone that I killed unjustly, without a reason, and I
oppressed them, it counts that I killed him once. If I killed a thousand people, their deaths will come on me,
and (if I killed one of) the Holy Prophet's Companions, it is as if I killed seventy times.”
Allah (swt) is saying, “O oppressors and tyrants in our times! You kill people who seek refuge and can’t find
anywhere safe. You follow them and kill them, and I will take their revenge on you, and I will not forget about
them!”
I am sorry to say that today, everywhere in Muslim territories there are seven or more oppressors killing
thousands and thousands of people. They will be punished by the Lord of Heavens, here, in their tombs, on
the Day of Resurrection and on Judgment Day. I am a weak servant but saying to tyrants and oppressors,
“Beware! You will be punished before leaving this life, in your last moment, in your tombs, on the Day of
Resurrection, on Judgment Day and you will be punished in Hells!”
I am not telling people fairy tales; that is a reality! I am warning all tyrants now, keep your hands from
innocent people or you will be punished!! If you do not believe that, in the last moment of your lives the
Almighty Divine will quickly take you away to the Fire to be punished.

Every day now, as the Seal of Prophets (s) informed us, there will be more and more earthquakes. If they do
not take care and repent, they will be under a heavy punishment of toppled mountains or buildings and no
one will be able to carry them out. Did you hear what is happening in Eastern Turkey? No one is safe or can
say, “Nothing can touch me.” No, it will touch those who forget their Creator, Allah Almighty, (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits) and who run after Shaytan, who is very happy to bring so many troubles on people
before the Last Day, and now they are entering their graveyards. May Allah (swt) forgive us!
O People! Remember Allah or you will be punished and regretful. O our Lord! We are asking for forgiveness,
for us, for all Muslims and all Mankind. Send us a heavenly one who will carry away bad people who are
Shaytan's agents.
O People! Don't follow Shaytan's representatives! In Turkey, Pakistan, Syria, Egypt, Libya, Tunis and
everywhere in the world, people are running to give others more trouble. They are dangerous people who
think they can do anything and that everything will be under their control, but one day their last breath will
come.
O People! Come and listen and save yourselves from the mightiness of the Lord of Heavens. We are weak, but
we claim to be powerful! We are not powerful.
May Allah forgive me and forgive you. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee... Allahuma thabitna `ala ‘lHaqq! Allahuma thabitna `ala ‘l-Haqq! Allahuma thabitna `ala ‘l-Haqq bi jaahi man anzalta `alayhi Surat alFatihah Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
